BLE Logger

Log all seen BLE devices to CSV with timestamps.

Passive Bluetooth Working today
Safe to explore. This is a passive / read-only tool — it listens and reports, it doesn't change anything or transmit attacks.

What it does

This is a Bluetooth tool. Log all seen BLE devices to CSV with timestamps.

How to use it

  1. Open BLE Logger from the Bluetooth category.
  2. Tap start — nearby Bluetooth LE devices are listed as they're found.
  3. Watch signal strength and any decoded details update live.
  4. Tap stop when you're done to save battery.

What happens on your hardware

On the Andraste Tablet: Uses the tablet's built-in Bluetooth — works out of the box.

On the Andraste CYD (ESP32): The ESP32 has Bluetooth too, so a version of this runs on the CYD.
